title: Edit draft invoice
purpose: Change an active internal draft’s billing details and charge amounts while preserving every original source test and the prior values in history.

good_to_know: Every line stays in the draft. To add a charge, use Add fee, discount or tax on the draft record. To cancel an amount, edit its price to zero with a reason.
Enter whole cents. Test, fee and tax prices are nonnegative; discounts are zero or negative. Tax quantity stays 1; review its amount after changing charges.
Tax never recalculates. Describe its basis or source; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Zero retains an explicit assessment.
If someone changes, issues or cancels the draft, reload to review its current state.
The due date is entered by staff, never calculated from payment terms. It does not establish a balance due.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can open or change invoice records. Drafts and issued records stay in the staff workspace. Staff issue an active draft from its detail page and deliver the PDF separately. Staff enter due dates and tax amounts. The invoice workflow has no payment or accounting entry.

items.label: Client name / Account code
items.description: The client name is required, up to 160 characters; account code is optional, up to 40. Copied from the client at creation and editable on the draft. Editing these labels does not change the source order or its client relationship.

items.label: Invoice-to contact / Invoice email
items.description: Optional contact name, up to 160 characters, and a valid email address. Initially copied from the invoice contact and email; blank invoice values use the primary contact and email. Nothing is emailed.

items.label: Billing address
items.description: Initially the invoice address, or the client mailing address when blank. Optional text, up to 4000 characters when edited. Line breaks are preserved.

items.label: Payment terms
items.description: Optional: Due on receipt, Net 15 days, Net 30 days, Net 45 days, Net 60 days or Prepaid. Initially the client terms. Information only; no due date or payment is calculated.

items.label: Due date
items.description: Optional payment date entered by staff, shown as YYYY-MM-DD or Not recorded. New drafts start blank. Set, change or clear it in Edit with a reason; past calendar dates are allowed. Payment terms never calculate or replace it. Issuance copies the saved date into the PDF when present. Any recorded date is kept with cancelled and voided records.

items.label: Purchase order
items.description: Optional text up to 60 characters. Initially the order PO, or the project standing PO when the order has none. A missing PO is not a draft-creation gate.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Fixed Test, Fee, Discount or Tax. Fees, discounts and tax have no sample or requested test. Tax is always manually added without a quote source. Quoted lines keep their quote number, version and source line; a line added by staff is marked Manually added and has no quote link. Kind and origin remain fixed through edits and cancellation. Discounts are signed amounts, not percentages.

items.label: Source sample and test
items.description: Read-only lab ID, client sample ID, disposition and test identity show what the line originally represented. Fee, discount and tax rows show No sample or requested test instead of sample or test details.

items.label: Description
items.description: Required text up to 400 characters. Editing it preserves the original test description alongside it. For tax, identify the assessment’s basis or source.

items.label: Quantity
items.description: Required whole number from 1 to 2,147,483,647. Starts at 1 for each source test; quoted fees and discounts retain their quoted quantity. Does not change the source quantity or sample/test count. Tax quantity must remain exactly 1.

items.label: Unit price (USD)
items.description: Required amount in whole cents, at most 9,999,999,999.99 USD in magnitude. Tests, fees and tax use nonnegative prices; discounts use zero or negative prices. Tax quantity is exactly 1. Prices are never automatically replaced from the source.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Required explanation, up to 2000 characters; kept with the old and new values.

items.label: Save draft
items.description: Checks every line and the revision and recomputes amounts and total exactly. Each line must fit 999,999,999,999.99 USD in magnitude; the total must be between zero and that limit. A negative total or a price with the wrong sign is refused. Saves changes and history together, then opens the draft record. Edits require an active draft. Issuance locks billing fields, charges and source details.

sections.title: Source and history
paragraphs: The draft keeps its source chain of custody, project, sample identities, requested test identities, method/version, matrix, unit, disposition and selected price-list name/revision or accepted quote version, acceptance snapshot and source quote lines. Each current requested test on a received sample creates one line, initially quantity 1. Each fee or discount from an accepted quote creates one additional line with its original quantity and signed price, without a sample or test identity. Held, rejected and qualified samples are included with their disposition; the preparer decides whether work is chargeable. Later source corrections, withdrawn tests and price changes do not update the draft.

Each order can have either one active draft or one issued invoice. A draft can have at most 200 combined test, fee, discount and tax lines. Every line and its kind and origin are retained; lines cannot be removed or reassigned. Use Add fee, discount or tax on the draft record to append a manual line with a reason, within the same bounds. To remove an unwanted amount, edit its price to zero with a reason. Cancel a draft and create a replacement to take a new source snapshot. A cancelled draft and its history remain readable. Invoice billing data never changes custody, results or released reports.

items.label: Errors and concurrent changes
items.description: Errors appear above the form or beside the field, with submitted values preserved. A source or revision change requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying. No partial draft or audit event is saved on failure.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Leave without saving. A dialog with changed input offers Keep editing or Discard changes. This ordinary Cancel action does not cancel an existing draft invoice.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size / Try again
items.description: Resize a dialog without saving, or retry a failed dialog load. On narrow screens the dialog uses the full screen. Wait for saving to finish before continuing.

items.label: Draft invoices / draft number
items.description: Breadcrumb links return to the directory or draft record without saving.

sections.title: Quote source
paragraphs: Editing descriptions, quantities or prices retains the original accepted quote version and line links. Changes require a reason and do not revise the accepted quote. An edited draft may differ from its original quote; there is no cumulative quote usage or accounting ledger.

sections.title: Explicit tax assessments
paragraphs: Tax assessments are entered manually on an active draft through Add fee, discount or tax. Each requires a description identifying its basis or source, quantity exactly 1 and a nonnegative whole-cent USD amount. Multiple assessments may be separate lines. Tax lines have no quote, sample or requested-test source. Creation from a price list or accepted quote never creates a tax line.

There are no tax rates, taxability or exemption decisions, or automatic tax calculations. The exact draft total includes every entered assessment. Changing test, fee or discount charges never recalculates tax: review each tax assessment separately after changing charges. Zero retains an explicit assessment; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Tax lines cannot be deleted or change kind; correct an amount to zero with a reason. Cancellation retains the lines and their history.
